claim_boundary: This proves a continuous-scale actual-positive-exponential rational-root family with raw Cycle-63 pair mass X^(22/25-o(1)). It disproves the uniform raw pair target X^(17/25+o(1)), but does not bound or refute the full fixed-beta triple census, prove a density gain, or prove an interval result.

exact_replay.boundary: This is a continuous-scale actual-positive-exponential rational-root family. It disproves a uniform raw Cycle-63 pair target, but its one-label triple mass is only X^(11/25+o(1)); it proves no density or interval result.
exact_replay.packet: For H>=8r, a central beta-zero seed gives an exact q=r, a=1 packet of depth floor(H/(4r)) wholly inside the row interval.
exact_replay.pair: All d=kr<=H are exact pair hits and have total weight at least H^2/(8r) for H>=4r.
exact_replay.rational_root: For Delta=2*pi*L/log(1+1/r), ell=L has alpha_ell=1/r exactly.
exact_replay.triple: At beta=0, exact strip rows in [H,2H] are precisely the multiples of r and number H/r+O(1).

rational_root_saturator.boundary: This is a continuous-scale actual-positive-exponential rational-root family. It disproves a uniform raw Cycle-63 pair target, but its one-label triple mass is only X^(11/25+o(1)); it proves no density or interval result.
rational_root_saturator.packet: For H>=8r, a central beta-zero seed gives an exact q=r, a=1 packet of depth floor(H/(4r)) wholly inside the row interval.
rational_root_saturator.pair: All d=kr<=H are exact pair hits and have total weight at least H^2/(8r) for H>=4r.
rational_root_saturator.rational_root: For Delta=2*pi*L/log(1+1/r), ell=L has alpha_ell=1/r exactly.
rational_root_saturator.triple: At beta=0, exact strip rows in [H,2H] are precisely the multiples of r and number H/r+O(1).

raw_pair_no_go.statement: For every fixed 0<c<1, a fixed rational root r and the continuous subsequence Delta_L=2*pi*L/log(1+1/r), X_L=Delta_L^(5/3) give an admissible label ell=L with P>>_c X_L^(22/25), so an unqualified uniform raw pair bound below X^(17/25) is false.

remaining_target.statement: Replace the raw pair route by a diagonal-aware direct triple census after extracting heavy seeded packets, or prove a heavy-actual-packet-to-seeded-recurrence theorem strong enough for E7/E9. Any further pair statistic must exclude or explicitly retain same-label rational-root rays.

sanity_scan.statement: The frozen 100-decimal scan on r in {1,2,3,5,8} and L in {10,100,1000} found every prescribed rational-root label inside the c=1/4 chart and no failed multiplier; the scan is not used for the proof.

structured_exception.statement: At beta=0 the constructed label has X^(11/25+o(1)) exact triple rows and a central exact seeded q=r,a=1 packet of depth X^(11/25+o(1)); this is a one-label structured exception, not a lower bound for the complete triple census.
